langchain_security_extension.security_core

Security Core package exports.

Re-exports core primitives including SecurityIdentity, PolicyDecisionEngine, AuditManager, CELEvaluator, and exception classes for zero-trust LLM security architecture.

class SecurityIdentity: 
 21class SecurityIdentity:
 22    """Immutable caller identity envelope containing authenticated attributes.
 23
 24    Attributes:
 25        subject_id (str): Unique subject identifier for caller identity.
 26        tenant_id (str): Multi-tenant isolation boundary identifier.
 27        roles (Set[str]): Set of security roles assigned to the subject.
 28        clearance_level (int): Numeric clearance rank assigned to identity.
 29        department_id (str): Department identifier for organizational access controls.
 30        attributes (Dict[str, Any]): Dynamic key-value pairs associated with identity.
 31    """
 32
 33    def __init__(
 34        self,
 35        subject_id: str,
 36        tenant_id: str,
 37        roles: Set[str],
 38        clearance_level: int,
 39        department_id: str,
 40        attributes: Dict[str, Any],
 41    ):
 42        """Initialize SecurityIdentity.
 43
 44        Args:
 45            subject_id: Subject identifier.
 46            tenant_id: Tenant isolation identifier.
 47            roles: Set of granted role strings.
 48            clearance_level: Numeric clearance level rank.
 49            department_id: Organizational department ID.
 50            attributes: Additional attribute key-value map.
 51        """
 52        self._subject_id = subject_id
 53        self._tenant_id = tenant_id
 54        self._roles = frozenset(roles)
 55        self._clearance_level = clearance_level
 56        self._department_id = department_id
 57        self._attributes = dict(attributes)
 58
 59    @classmethod
 60    def create(
 61        self_cls,
 62        subject_id: str,
 63        tenant_id: str,
 64        roles: Set[str],
 65        clearance_level: int,
 66        department_id: str,
 67        *args: Any,
 68        **kwargs: Any,
 69    ):
 70        """Factory method to construct a new SecurityIdentity instance.
 71
 72        Args:
 73            subject_id: Caller subject identifier.
 74            tenant_id: Tenant identifier.
 75            roles: Set of role strings.
 76            clearance_level: Clearance level rank.
 77            department_id: Department ID.
 78            *args: Optional positional attributes map.
 79            **kwargs: Optional keyword attributes map.
 80
 81        Returns:
 82            SecurityIdentity: Constructed immutable identity object.
 83        """
 84        attributes: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = args[0] if len(args) > 0 else kwargs.get("attributes")
 85        return self_cls(
 86            subject_id=subject_id,
 87            tenant_id=tenant_id,
 88            roles=roles,
 89            clearance_level=clearance_level,
 90            department_id=department_id,
 91            attributes=attributes if isinstance(attributes, dict) else {},
 92        )
 93
 94    @classmethod
 95    def anonymous(self_cls):
 96        """Factory method constructing an unprivileged anonymous identity.
 97
 98        Returns:
 99            SecurityIdentity: Default anonymous identity envelope.
100        """
101        return self_cls(
102            subject_id=ANONYMOUS_SUBJECT_ID,
103            tenant_id=DEFAULT_TENANT_ID,
104            roles=set(),
105            clearance_level=DEFAULT_CLEARANCE_LEVEL,
106            department_id=DEFAULT_DEPARTMENT_ID,
107            attributes={},
108        )
109
110    @property
111    def subject_id(self) -> str:
112        """Get the unique subject identifier."""
113        return self._subject_id
114
115    @property
116    def tenant_id(self) -> str:
117        """Get the tenant isolation boundary identifier."""
118        return self._tenant_id
119
120    @property
121    def roles(self) -> Set[str]:
122        """Get the set of role entitlements held by this identity."""
123        return set(self._roles)
124
125    @property
126    def clearance_level(self) -> int:
127        """Get the numeric clearance rank of this identity."""
128        return self._clearance_level
129
130    @property
131    def department_id(self) -> str:
132        """Get the department identifier of this identity."""
133        return self._department_id
134
135    @property
136    def is_anonymous(self) -> bool:
137        """Return True if identity represents an anonymous or unauthenticated subject."""
138        return bool(self._subject_id is None or str(self._subject_id).upper() == ANONYMOUS_SUBJECT_ID)
139
140    @property
141    def attributes(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
142        """Get a copy of dynamic attributes attached to identity."""
143        return dict(self._attributes)
144
145    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
146        """Serialize SecurityIdentity into a JSON-compatible dictionary.
147
148        Returns:
149            Dict[str, Any]: Serialized identity dictionary.
150        """
151        return {
152            "subject_id": self._subject_id,
153            "tenant_id": self._tenant_id,
154            "roles": list(self._roles),
155            "clearance_level": self._clearance_level,
156            "department_id": self._department_id,
157            "attributes": self._attributes,
158        }
159
160    @classmethod
161    def from_dict(self_cls, data: Dict[str, Any]):
162        """Deserialize dictionary into a SecurityIdentity instance.
163
164        Args:
165            data: Dictionary containing identity fields.
166
167        Returns:
168            SecurityIdentity: Constructed identity instance.
169        """
170        return self_cls(
171            subject_id=data.get("subject_id", ANONYMOUS_SUBJECT_ID),
172            tenant_id=data.get("tenant_id", DEFAULT_TENANT_ID),
173            roles=set(data.get("roles", [])),
174            clearance_level=int(data.get("clearance_level", DEFAULT_CLEARANCE_LEVEL)),
175            department_id=data.get("department_id", DEFAULT_DEPARTMENT_ID),
176            attributes=dict(data.get("attributes", {})),
177        )
178
179    def with_trace_context(
180        self,
181        trace_id: Optional[str],
182        span_id: Optional[str],
183    ) -> "SecurityIdentity":
184        """Return a new SecurityIdentity with W3C OpenTelemetry trace and span identifiers attached.
185
186        Args:
187            trace_id: OpenTelemetry 32-character hexadecimal trace identifier.
188            span_id: OpenTelemetry 16-character hexadecimal span identifier.
189
190        Returns:
191            SecurityIdentity: New immutable identity instance containing the trace context.
192        """
193        attrs = dict(self._attributes)
194        if trace_id is not None:
195            attrs["trace_id"] = trace_id
196        if span_id is not None:
197            attrs["span_id"] = span_id
198        return self.__class__.create(
199            subject_id=self._subject_id,
200            tenant_id=self._tenant_id,
201            roles=self.roles,
202            clearance_level=self._clearance_level,
203            department_id=self._department_id,
204            attributes=attrs,
205        )

208class InvocationParameters:
209    """In-band execution parameters envelope carried inside framework metadata/state.
210
211    Attributes:
212        security_identity (SecurityIdentity): Caller identity envelope.
213        metadata (Dict[str, Any]): Framework invocation metadata dictionary.

315    @staticmethod
316    def resolve_identity(candidate_identity: Optional[SecurityIdentity]) -> SecurityIdentity:
317        """Resolve identity from candidate, current context holder, or fall back to anonymous identity.
318
319        Args:
320            candidate_identity: Direct identity instance if available.
321
322        Returns:
323            SecurityIdentity: Resolved identity object.
324        """
325        if candidate_identity is not None:
326            return candidate_identity
327        ctx_identity = SecurityContextHolder.get_identity()
328        if ctx_identity is not None:
329            return ctx_identity
330        return SecurityIdentity.anonymous()

332    @staticmethod
333    def extract_from_config(config: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Optional[SecurityIdentity]:
334        """Extract SecurityIdentity from Runnable standard config dictionary.
335
336        Args:
337            config: Runnable config dictionary containing 'configurable' keys.
338
339        Returns:
340            Optional[SecurityIdentity]: Extracted identity object or None if missing.
341        """
342        if not config or not isinstance(config, dict):
343            return None
344        configurable = config.get("configurable")
345        if isinstance(configurable, dict):
346            sec_id = configurable.get("security_identity")
347            if isinstance(sec_id, SecurityIdentity):
348                return sec_id
349            elif isinstance(sec_id, dict):
350                return SecurityIdentity.from_dict(sec_id)
351        return None

355        """Wrap SecurityIdentity into native LangChain RunnableConfig dictionary.
356

359
360        Returns:
361            Dict[str, Any]: RunnableConfig dictionary with 'configurable' mapping.
362        """
363        return {
364            "configurable": {
365                "security_identity": identity
366            }
367        }

369    @classmethod
370    def build_identity_from_claims(
371        cls,
372        claims: Dict[str, Any],
373        clearance_rank_map: Optional[Dict[str, int]],
374        default_clearance: int,
375    ) -> SecurityIdentity:
376        """Construct SecurityIdentity from verified JWT claims or caller metadata.
377
378        Args:
379            claims: Token claims or user identity mapping.
380            clearance_rank_map: Optional mapping of clearance names to numeric ranks.
381            default_clearance: Numeric clearance rank floor.
382
383        Returns:
384            SecurityIdentity: Immutable security envelope.
385        """
386        sub = str(claims.get("sub") or claims.get("email") or claims.get("user_id") or ANONYMOUS_SUBJECT_ID)
387        tenant = str(claims.get("tenantId") or claims.get("tenant_id") or DEFAULT_TENANT_ID)
388        dept = str(claims.get("department") or claims.get("dept") or DEFAULT_DEPARTMENT_ID)
389
390        raw_roles = claims.get("roles") or claims.get("assignedRoles") or []
391        roles_set: Set[str] = set()
392        if isinstance(raw_roles, list):
393            for r in raw_roles:
394                if isinstance(r, str):
395                    roles_set.update([role.strip() for role in r.split(",") if role.strip()])
396        elif isinstance(raw_roles, str):
397            roles_set.update([role.strip() for role in raw_roles.split(",") if role.strip()])
398
399        raw_clr = claims.get("clearanceLevel") or claims.get("clearance") or claims.get("clearance_level")
400        if isinstance(raw_clr, int):
401            clr = raw_clr
402        elif isinstance(raw_clr, str) and raw_clr.isdigit():
403            clr = int(raw_clr)
404        elif clearance_rank_map and isinstance(raw_clr, str):
405            clr = clearance_rank_map.get(raw_clr.upper(), default_clearance)
406        elif clearance_rank_map and roles_set:
407            role_ranks = [clearance_rank_map.get(r, default_clearance) for r in roles_set if r != "ROLE_GUEST"]
408            clr = max(role_ranks) if role_ranks else default_clearance
409        else:
410            clr = default_clearance
411
412        attrs = dict(claims.get("attributes", {}))
413        if claims.get("trace_id"):
414            attrs["trace_id"] = claims["trace_id"]
415        if claims.get("span_id"):
416            attrs["span_id"] = claims["span_id"]
417
418        return SecurityIdentity.create(
419            subject_id=sub,
420            tenant_id=tenant,
421            roles=roles_set,
422            clearance_level=clr,
423            department_id=dept,
424            attributes=attrs,
425        )
426
427    def resolve_identity_from_context(self, headers_or_context: Dict[str, Any]) -> SecurityIdentity:
428        """Abstract method for resolving identity from raw request context or HTTP headers.
429
430        Args:
431            headers_or_context: Context or headers mapping.
432
433        Returns:
434            SecurityIdentity: Resolved identity.
435
436        Raises:
437            NotImplementedError: If subclass does not implement method.
438        """
439        raise NotImplementedError("Subclasses must implement resolve_identity_from_context")
440

547            enforcement_point=ENFORCEMENT_POINT_IDENTITY_BRIDGE,
548            reason_code=REASON_AUTHENTICATION_SUCCESS,
549        )
550        if trace_id:
551            event.trace_id = trace_id
552        if span_id:
553            event.span_id = span_id
554        if audit_manager:
555            audit_manager.record_event(event)
556        return event

Record successful identity authentication event to audit manager.

Args: audit_manager: Target audit manager. subject_id: Subject identifier. tenant_id: Tenant identifier. action: Action identifier. resource: Resource identifier. department: Department ID. roles: List of granted roles. clearance_level: Clearance rank. trace_id: OpenTelemetry trace ID. span_id: OpenTelemetry span ID.

193        """Factory method creating a DENY decision.
194

197            obligations: Enforcement obligations dictionary (e.g., handling strategy).

199        Returns:

204    @classmethod

206        """Factory method creating a NOT_APPLICABLE decision.
207
208        Args:

211        Returns:

216    @classmethod
217    def indeterminate(cls, diagnostic_reason: str):
218        """Factory method creating an INDETERMINATE decision.
219
220        Args:
221            diagnostic_reason: Error rationale description.
222
223        Returns:

230        """Get raw decision verdict string."""

233    @property

248    @property

250        """Get obligations formatted as string list for legacy compatibility.
251
252        Returns:

255        res: List[str] = []

258            res.append(str(strategy))
259        for k, v in self._obligations.items():
260            if k != "strategy":
261                res.append(f"{k}:{v}")
262        return res

266        """Check if decision is PERMIT.
267
268        Returns:
269            bool: True if decision is PERMIT, False otherwise.
270        """
271        return self._decision == DECISION_PERMIT

class EmbeddedPolicyEngine(langchain_security_extension.security_core.PolicyDecisionEngine): 
593class EmbeddedPolicyEngine(PolicyDecisionEngine):
594    """In-memory PDP evaluating tenant, clearance, roles, and CEL constraints with Deny-Overrides rules."""
595
596    def __init__(
597        self,
598        role_graph: RoleGraph,
599        cel_evaluator: CELEvaluator,
600        audit_manager: AuditManager,
601        *args: Any,
602        **kwargs: Any,
603    ):
604        """Initialize EmbeddedPolicyEngine.
605
606        Args:
607            role_graph: RoleGraph instance for role inheritance expansion.
608            cel_evaluator: CELEvaluator instance for parameter expression validation.
609            audit_manager: AuditManager instance for security event logging.
610            *args: Optional positional arguments (rules, decision_cache).
611            **kwargs: Optional keyword arguments (rules, decision_cache).
612        """
613        rules = kwargs.get("rules", args[0] if len(args) > 0 else None)
614        decision_cache = kwargs.get("decision_cache", args[1] if len(args) > 1 else None)
615        self._role_graph = role_graph
616        self._cel_evaluator = cel_evaluator
617        self._audit_manager = audit_manager
618        self._rules = list(rules) if rules is not None else []
619        self._cache = decision_cache if isinstance(decision_cache, TwoTierDecisionCache) else TwoTierDecisionCache.create()
620        self.enforce_strict_tenant_isolation = True
621        self._invalidation_callbacks: List[Any] = []
622
623    @classmethod
624    def create(cls):
625        """Factory method constructing default EmbeddedPolicyEngine.
626
627        Returns:
628            EmbeddedPolicyEngine: Engine initialized with default components.
629        """
630        return cls(
631            role_graph=RoleGraph.create(),
632            cel_evaluator=CELEvaluator.create(),
633            audit_manager=AuditManager.create(publishers=[]),
634        )
635
636    @classmethod
637    def with_components(
638        cls,
639        role_graph: RoleGraph,
640        cel_evaluator: CELEvaluator,
641        audit_manager: AuditManager,
642        *args: Any,
643        **kwargs: Any,
644    ):
645        """Factory method constructing EmbeddedPolicyEngine with specified components.
646
647        Args:
648            role_graph: Custom RoleGraph.
649            cel_evaluator: Custom CELEvaluator.
650            audit_manager: Custom AuditManager.
651            *args: Optional positional arguments (rules, decision_cache).
652            **kwargs: Optional keyword arguments (rules, decision_cache).
653
654        Returns:
655            EmbeddedPolicyEngine: Engine instance.
656        """
657        return cls(
658            role_graph,
659            cel_evaluator,
660            audit_manager,
661            *args,
662            **kwargs,
663        )
664
665    @property
666    def role_graph(self) -> RoleGraph:
667        """Get the configured RoleGraph."""
668        return self._role_graph
669
670    @property
671    def audit_manager(self) -> AuditManager:
672        """Get the configured AuditManager."""
673        return self._audit_manager
674
675    @property
676    def decision_cache(self) -> TwoTierDecisionCache:
677        """Get the configured TwoTierDecisionCache."""
678        return self._cache
679
680    def register_invalidation_callback(self, callback: Any) -> None:
681        """Register a callback to be invoked upon cache eviction or subject invalidation.
682
683        Args:
684            callback: Callable invoked with subject_id on subject eviction, or with no arguments on full cache clear.
685        """
686        self._invalidation_callbacks.append(callback)
687
688    def clear_cache(self) -> None:
689        """Flush all Tier 2 static cache entries and trigger registered invalidation callbacks."""
690        self._cache.flush()
691        for cb in list(getattr(self, "_invalidation_callbacks", [])):
692            try:
693                cb()
694            except Exception:
695                pass
696
697    def evict_subject_cache(self, subject_id: str, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> int:
698        """Evict cached decisions for a subject upon role revocation and emit an audit event.
699
700        Args:
701            subject_id: Subject identifier whose cached decisions are invalidated.
702            *args: Optional positional config dict.
703            **kwargs: Optional keyword config dict.
704
705        Returns:
706            int: Count of evicted entries.
707        """
708        evicted_count = self._cache.evict_subject(subject_id, *args, **kwargs)
709        for cb in list(getattr(self, "_invalidation_callbacks", [])):
710            try:
711                cb(subject_id)
712            except Exception:
713                pass
714        event = AuditEvent.create(
715            subject_id=subject_id,
716            tenant_id=str(kwargs.get("tenant_id", "DEFAULT")),
717            action="pdp:cache_evict",
718            resource="TwoTierDecisionCache",
719            decision=DECISION_PERMIT,
720            diagnostic_reason=f"{EVENT_CACHE_EVICTED}: Evicted {evicted_count} cached decisions for {subject_id}",
721            severity=SEVERITY_INFORMATIONAL,
722            metadata={"evicted_count": evicted_count},
723            reason_code=EVENT_CACHE_EVICTED,
724        )
725        self._audit_manager.record_event(event)
726        return evicted_count
727
728    def add_rule(self, rule: PolicyRule) -> None:
729        """Add a PolicyRule to engine rule store.
730
731        Args:
732            rule: PolicyRule instance.
733        """
734        self._rules.append(rule)
735
736    def evaluate(self, request: PolicyEvaluationRequest) -> PolicyDecision:
737        """Evaluate access request through tenant isolation, quarantine, clearance lattice, roles, and CEL constraints.
738
739        Args:
740            request: Evaluation request envelope.
741
742        Returns:
743            PolicyDecision: Evaluation decision status and obligations.
744        """
745        subject = request.subject
746        resource = request.resource
747        req_config = request.context.get("config") if isinstance(request.context, dict) else None
748
749        # Check Tier 1 Invocation Cache and Tier 2 Static Cache
750        cache_key = self._cache.compute_request_hash(request)
751        tier1_decision = self._cache.get_invocation_cache(req_config, cache_key)
752        if tier1_decision:
753            if req_config and isinstance(req_config, dict) and isinstance(req_config.get("configurable"), dict):
754                req_config["configurable"]["sec:pdp_cache_hit"] = True
755                req_config["configurable"]["sec:pdp_cache_tier"] = "tier1"
756            return tier1_decision
757        cached_decision = self._cache.get_static(cache_key)
758        if cached_decision:
759            if req_config and isinstance(req_config, dict) and isinstance(req_config.get("configurable"), dict):
760                req_config["configurable"]["sec:pdp_cache_hit"] = True
761                req_config["configurable"]["sec:pdp_cache_tier"] = "tier2"
762            return cached_decision
763
764        # 0. Quarantine Check
765        is_quarantined = bool(resource.get("sec:quarantined") or resource.get("quarantined"))
766        if is_quarantined:
767            expanded_roles = self._role_graph.expand_roles(subject.roles)
768            if "ROLE_ADMIN" not in expanded_roles or subject.clearance_level < 3:
769                decision = self._record_and_return(
770                    request=request,
771                    decision_status=DECISION_DENY,
772                    diagnostic_reason=REASON_QUARANTINED_CHUNK,
773                    severity=SEVERITY_WARNING,
774                    obligations={},
775                    reason_code=REASON_QUARANTINED_CHUNK,
776                )
777                self._cache.put_static(cache_key, decision)
778                return decision
779
780        # 0.1 Unauthenticated Subject Check (Fail-closed for anonymous unless explicitly permitted by rule)
781        is_anon = (
782            subject is None
783            or subject.is_anonymous
784            or subject.subject_id is None
785            or str(subject.subject_id).upper() == ANONYMOUS_SUBJECT_ID
786        )
787        if is_anon:
788            anon_permitted = False
789            if self._rules:
790                for rule in self._rules:
791                    if (rule.target_action == "*" or rule.target_action == request.action) and rule.effect == DECISION_PERMIT:
792                        anon_permitted = True
793                        break
794            if not anon_permitted:
795                decision = self._record_and_return(
796                    request=request,
797                    decision_status=DECISION_DENY,
798                    diagnostic_reason=REASON_UNAUTHENTICATED,
799                    severity=SEVERITY_WARNING,
800                    obligations={},
801                    reason_code=REASON_UNAUTHENTICATED,
802                )
803                self._cache.put_static(cache_key, decision)
804                return decision
805
806        # 1. Multi-Tenancy Check
807        required_tenant = resource.get("tenant_id")
808        if required_tenant:
809            tenant_mismatch = (subject.tenant_id not in required_tenant) if isinstance(required_tenant, (set, list, tuple)) else (required_tenant != subject.tenant_id)
810            if tenant_mismatch:
811                reason_code = EVENT_TENANT_BOUND_VIOLATION if self.enforce_strict_tenant_isolation else None
812                severity = SEVERITY_CRITICAL_ALERT if self.enforce_strict_tenant_isolation else SEVERITY_WARNING
813                decision = self._record_and_return(
814                    request=request,
815                    decision_status=DECISION_DENY,
816                    diagnostic_reason=REASON_TENANT_MISMATCH,
817                    severity=severity,
818                    obligations={},
819                    reason_code=reason_code,
820                )
821                self._cache.put_static(cache_key, decision)
822                return decision
823
824        # 2. Clearance Lattice Check (Supports numeric rank or string classification level)
825        req_clr_val = resource.get("min_clearance") or resource.get("clearance_floor") or resource.get("sec:clearance_level")
826        if req_clr_val is not None:
827            req_rank = CLASSIFICATION_TO_RANK.get(str(req_clr_val).upper(), int(req_clr_val) if str(req_clr_val).isdigit() else 0)
828            subj_rank = subject.clearance_level
829            if subj_rank < req_rank:
830                decision = self._record_and_return(
831                    request=request,
832                    decision_status=DECISION_DENY,
833                    diagnostic_reason=REASON_INSUFFICIENT_CLEARANCE,
834                    severity=SEVERITY_WARNING,
835                    obligations={},
836                    reason_code=None,
837                )
838                self._cache.put_static(cache_key, decision)
839                return decision
840
841        # 3. Role Inheritance Matching
842        required_roles = resource.get("required_roles") or resource.get("sec:required_roles") or resource.get("sec:allowed_roles")
843        if required_roles:
844            expanded_roles = self._role_graph.expand_roles(subject.roles)
845            if not set(required_roles).intersection(expanded_roles):
846                decision = self._record_and_return(
847                    request=request,
848                    decision_status=DECISION_DENY,
849                    diagnostic_reason=REASON_MISSING_REQUIRED_ROLE,
850                    severity=SEVERITY_WARNING,
851                    obligations={},
852                    reason_code=None,
853                )
854                self._cache.put_static(cache_key, decision)
855                return decision
856
857        # 4. CEL Parameter Expression Evaluation
858        cel_expression = resource.get("cel_expression")
859        if cel_expression:
860            runtime_args = resource.get("arguments", {})
861            tool_meta = resource.get("tool_metadata", {})
862            passed = self._cel_evaluator.evaluate(
863                expression=cel_expression,
864                subject=subject,
865                args=runtime_args,
866                tool=tool_meta,
867                config=req_config,
868            )
869            if not passed:
870                strategy = STRATEGY_HARD_ABORT if resource.get("is_mutative") else STRATEGY_RETURN_FEEDBACK
871                diag_reason = REASON_PARAMETER_CONSTRAINT_FAILED
872                if self._cel_evaluator.last_diagnostic_reason:
873                    diag_reason = self._cel_evaluator.last_diagnostic_reason
874                elif "entities." in str(cel_expression):
875                    diag_reason = "CEL_HYDRATION_FAILED (hydrated owner mismatch)"
876                decision = self._record_and_return(
877                    request=request,
878                    decision_status=DECISION_DENY,
879                    diagnostic_reason=diag_reason,
880                    severity=SEVERITY_SECURITY_ALERT,
881                    obligations={"strategy": strategy},
882                    reason_code=None,
883                )
884                self._cache.put_static(cache_key, decision)
885                return decision
886
887        # 5. Declarative Deny-Overrides Evaluation (if custom rules are defined)
888        if self._rules:
889            matched_permit = False
890            for rule in self._rules:
891                if rule.target_action == "*" or rule.target_action == request.action:
892                    # Validate rule constraints: roles, clearance, cel_condition
893                    rule_matches = True
894
895                    if rule.required_roles:
896                        expanded_roles = self._role_graph.expand_roles(subject.roles)
897                        if not set(rule.required_roles).intersection(expanded_roles):
898                            rule_matches = False
899
900                    if rule_matches and rule.min_clearance is not None:
901                        if subject.clearance_level < int(rule.min_clearance):
902                            rule_matches = False
903
904                    if rule_matches and rule.cel_condition:
905                        runtime_args = resource.get("arguments", {})
906                        tool_meta = resource.get("tool_metadata", {})
907                        if not self._cel_evaluator.evaluate(
908                            expression=rule.cel_condition,
909                            subject=subject,
910                            args=runtime_args,
911                            tool=tool_meta,
912                            config=req_config,
913                        ):
914                            rule_matches = False
915
916                    if rule_matches:
917                        if rule.effect == DECISION_DENY:
918                            decision = self._record_and_return(
919                                request=request,
920                                decision_status=DECISION_DENY,
921                                diagnostic_reason=f"Rule {rule.rule_id} DENY",
922                                severity=SEVERITY_SECURITY_ALERT,
923                                obligations={"strategy": rule.on_denial},
924                                reason_code=None,
925                            )
926                            self._cache.put_static(cache_key, decision)
927                            return decision
928                        elif rule.effect == DECISION_PERMIT:
929                            matched_permit = True
930
931            if not matched_permit:
932                decision = self._record_and_return(
933                    request=request,
934                    decision_status=DECISION_NOT_APPLICABLE,
935                    diagnostic_reason="No matching permit policy rule found",
936                    severity=SEVERITY_WARNING,
937                    obligations={},
938                    reason_code=None,
939                )
940                self._cache.put_static(cache_key, decision)
941                return decision
942
943        # 6. Permit Default
944        decision = self._record_and_return(
945            request=request,
946            decision_status=DECISION_PERMIT,
947            diagnostic_reason=REASON_AUTHORIZED,
948            severity=SEVERITY_INFORMATIONAL,
949            obligations={},
950            reason_code=None,
951        )
952        self._cache.put_static(cache_key, decision)
953        return decision
954
955    def _record_and_return(
956        self,
957        request: PolicyEvaluationRequest,
958        decision_status: str,
959        diagnostic_reason: str,
960        severity: str,
961        obligations: Dict[str, Any],
962        reason_code: Optional[str],
963    ) -> PolicyDecision:
964        resource_id = str(request.resource.get("name") or request.resource.get("target_id") or "UNKNOWN")
965        event = AuditEvent.create(
966            subject_id=request.subject.subject_id,
967            tenant_id=request.subject.tenant_id,
968            action=request.action,
969            resource=resource_id,
970            decision=decision_status,
971            diagnostic_reason=diagnostic_reason,
972            severity=severity,
973            metadata={"obligations": obligations},
974            reason_code=reason_code,
975        )
976        if reason_code == EVENT_TENANT_BOUND_VIOLATION:
977            event.threat_category = "IDENTITY_SPOOFING"
978            event.mitigation_action = "BLOCKED"
979        self._audit_manager.record_event(event)
980
981        dec = PolicyDecision.create(
982            decision=decision_status,
983            diagnostic_reason=diagnostic_reason,
984            obligations=obligations,
985        )
986        req_config = request.context.get("config") if isinstance(request.context, dict) else None
987        if req_config:
988            cache_key = self._cache.compute_request_hash(request)
989            self._cache.put_invocation_cache(req_config, cache_key, dec)
990        return dec

In-memory PDP evaluating tenant, clearance, roles, and CEL constraints with Deny-Overrides rules.

860            runtime_args = resource.get("arguments", {})
861            tool_meta = resource.get("tool_metadata", {})
862            passed = self._cel_evaluator.evaluate(
863                expression=cel_expression,
864                subject=subject,
865                args=runtime_args,
866                tool=tool_meta,
867                config=req_config,
868            )
869            if not passed:
870                strategy = STRATEGY_HARD_ABORT if resource.get("is_mutative") else STRATEGY_RETURN_FEEDBACK
871                diag_reason = REASON_PARAMETER_CONSTRAINT_FAILED
872                if self._cel_evaluator.last_diagnostic_reason:
873                    diag_reason = self._cel_evaluator.last_diagnostic_reason
874                elif "entities." in str(cel_expression):
875                    diag_reason = "CEL_HYDRATION_FAILED (hydrated owner mismatch)"
876                decision = self._record_and_return(
877                    request=request,
878                    decision_status=DECISION_DENY,
879                    diagnostic_reason=diag_reason,
880                    severity=SEVERITY_SECURITY_ALERT,
881                    obligations={"strategy": strategy},
882                    reason_code=None,
883                )
884                self._cache.put_static(cache_key, decision)
885                return decision
886
887        # 5. Declarative Deny-Overrides Evaluation (if custom rules are defined)
888        if self._rules:
889            matched_permit = False
890            for rule in self._rules:
891                if rule.target_action == "*" or rule.target_action == request.action:
892                    # Validate rule constraints: roles, clearance, cel_condition
893                    rule_matches = True
894
895                    if rule.required_roles:
896                        expanded_roles = self._role_graph.expand_roles(subject.roles)
897                        if not set(rule.required_roles).intersection(expanded_roles):
898                            rule_matches = False
899
900                    if rule_matches and rule.min_clearance is not None:
901                        if subject.clearance_level < int(rule.min_clearance):
902                            rule_matches = False
903
904                    if rule_matches and rule.cel_condition:
905                        runtime_args = resource.get("arguments", {})
906                        tool_meta = resource.get("tool_metadata", {})
907                        if not self._cel_evaluator.evaluate(
908                            expression=rule.cel_condition,
909                            subject=subject,
910                            args=runtime_args,
911                            tool=tool_meta,
912                            config=req_config,
913                        ):
914                            rule_matches = False
915
916                    if rule_matches:
917                        if rule.effect == DECISION_DENY:
918                            decision = self._record_and_return(
919                                request=request,
920                                decision_status=DECISION_DENY,
921                                diagnostic_reason=f"Rule {rule.rule_id} DENY",
922                                severity=SEVERITY_SECURITY_ALERT,
923                                obligations={"strategy": rule.on_denial},
924                                reason_code=None,
925                            )
926                            self._cache.put_static(cache_key, decision)
927                            return decision
928                        elif rule.effect == DECISION_PERMIT:
929                            matched_permit = True
930
931            if not matched_permit:
932                decision = self._record_and_return(
933                    request=request,
934                    decision_status=DECISION_NOT_APPLICABLE,
935                    diagnostic_reason="No matching permit policy rule found",
936                    severity=SEVERITY_WARNING,
937                    obligations={},
938                    reason_code=None,
939                )
940                self._cache.put_static(cache_key, decision)
941                return decision
942
943        # 6. Permit Default
944        decision = self._record_and_return(
945            request=request,
946            decision_status=DECISION_PERMIT,
947            diagnostic_reason=REASON_AUTHORIZED,
948            severity=SEVERITY_INFORMATIONAL,
949            obligations={},
950            reason_code=None,
951        )
952        self._cache.put_static(cache_key, decision)
953        return decision

Evaluate access request through tenant isolation, quarantine, clearance lattice, roles, and CEL constraints.

Args: request: Evaluation request envelope.

Returns: PolicyDecision: Evaluation decision status and obligations.

class RoleGraph: 
274class RoleGraph:
275    """Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) for hierarchical role inheritance resolution."""
276
277    def __init__(self):
278        """Initialize empty RoleGraph."""
279        self._inheritance: Dict[str, Set[str]] = {}
280
281    @classmethod
282    def create(cls):
283        """Factory method creating a RoleGraph.
284
285        Returns:
286            RoleGraph: New RoleGraph instance.
287        """
288        return cls()
289
290    def add_inheritance(self, parent_role: str, child_role: str) -> None:
291        """Declares that parent_role inherits child_role permissions.
292
293        Args:
294            parent_role: Role that inherits permissions.
295            child_role: Role whose permissions are inherited.
296
297        Raises:
298            ValueError: If adding inheritance creates a cyclic role graph.
299        """
300        if parent_role not in self._inheritance:
301            self._inheritance[parent_role] = set()
302        self._inheritance[parent_role].add(child_role)
303        self._assert_no_cycles()
304
305    def expand_roles(self, roles: Set[str]) -> Set[str]:
306        """Transitively expands assigned roles through graph hierarchy.
307
308        Args:
309            roles: Base set of assigned caller roles.
310
311        Returns:
312            Set[str]: Expanded set including all inherited roles.
313        """
314        expanded: Set[str] = set()
315        visited: Set[str] = set()
316
317        def dfs(role: str) -> None:
318            if role in visited:
319                return
320            visited.add(role)
321            expanded.add(role)
322            for child in self._inheritance.get(role, set()):
323                dfs(child)
324
325        for r in roles:
326            dfs(r)
327        return expanded
328
329    def _assert_no_cycles(self) -> None:
330        visited: Set[str] = set()
331        rec_stack: Set[str] = set()
332
333        def has_cycle(node: str) -> bool:
334            visited.add(node)
335            rec_stack.add(node)
336            for neighbor in self._inheritance.get(node, set()):
337                if neighbor not in visited:
338                    if has_cycle(neighbor):
339                        return True
340                elif neighbor in rec_stack:
341                    return True
342            rec_stack.remove(node)
343            return False
344
345        for role in self._inheritance:
346            if role not in visited:
347                if has_cycle(role):
348                    raise ValueError(f"Cyclic role inheritance detected at role: '{role}'")

Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) for hierarchical role inheritance resolution.

432class TwoTierDecisionCache:
433    """Two-tier caching engine (Tier 1 Invocation-Scoped + Tier 2 Cross-Request Static)."""
434
435    def __init__(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any):
436        """Initialize TwoTierDecisionCache.
437
438        Args:
439            *args: Optional positional arguments (ttl_seconds, max_entries, l1_enabled, l2_enabled).
440            **kwargs: Optional keyword arguments.
441        """
442        ttl_seconds = kwargs.get("ttl_seconds", args[0] if len(args) > 0 else DEFAULT_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS)
443        max_entries = kwargs.get("max_entries", args[1] if len(args) > 1 else DEFAULT_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES)
444        l1_enabled = kwargs.get("l1_enabled", args[2] if len(args) > 2 else True)
445        l2_enabled = kwargs.get("l2_enabled", args[3] if len(args) > 3 else True)
446        self._tier2_cache: Dict[str, tuple[PolicyDecision, float]] = {}
447        self._ttl_seconds = float(ttl_seconds)
448        self._max_entries = int(max_entries)
449        self._l1_enabled = bool(l1_enabled)
450        self._l2_enabled = bool(l2_enabled)
451
452    @classmethod
453    def create(cls, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any):
454        """Factory method creating TwoTierDecisionCache.
455
456        Args:
457            *args: Optional positional arguments.
458            **kwargs: Optional keyword arguments.
459
460        Returns:
461            TwoTierDecisionCache: New cache instance.
462        """
463        return cls(*args, **kwargs)
464
465    @property
466    def l1_enabled(self) -> bool:
467        """Check if Tier 1 invocation cache is enabled."""
468        return self._l1_enabled
469
470    @property
471    def l2_enabled(self) -> bool:
472        """Check if Tier 2 static cache is enabled."""
473        return self._l2_enabled
474
475    def compute_request_hash(self, request: PolicyEvaluationRequest) -> str:
476        """Compute SHA256 deterministic hash key prefixed by subject_id for an evaluation request.
477
478        Args:
479            request: Policy evaluation request object.
480
481        Returns:
482            str: Subject-prefixed hexadecimal SHA256 digest string.
483        """
484        res_str = json.dumps(request.resource, sort_keys=True, default=str)
485        roles_str = ",".join(sorted(list(request.subject.roles))) if request.subject.roles else ""
486        s = f"{request.subject.subject_id}:{request.subject.tenant_id}:{request.subject.clearance_level}:{request.subject.department_id}:{roles_str}:{request.action}:{res_str}"
487        digest = hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest()
488        return f"{request.subject.subject_id}:{digest}"
489
490    def get_invocation_cache(self, config: Optional[Dict[str, Any]], cache_key: str) -> Optional[PolicyDecision]:
491        """Tier 1: Looks up decision in RunnableConfig['configurable']['sec:decision_cache'].
492
493        Args:
494            config: RunnableConfig dictionary.
495            cache_key: Request hash key.
496
497        Returns:
498            Optional[PolicyDecision]: Cached decision or None if miss.
499        """
500        if not self._l1_enabled or not config or not isinstance(config, dict):
501            return None
502        configurable = config.get("configurable")
503        if isinstance(configurable, dict):
504            inv_cache = configurable.get(CONFIG_KEY_DECISION_CACHE)
505            if isinstance(inv_cache, dict):
506                return inv_cache.get(cache_key)
507        return None
508
509    def put_invocation_cache(self, config: Optional[Dict[str, Any]], cache_key: str, decision: PolicyDecision) -> None:
510        """Tier 1: Stores decision in RunnableConfig['configurable']['sec:decision_cache'].
511
512        Args:
513            config: Target RunnableConfig dictionary.
514            cache_key: Request hash key.
515            decision: Computed PolicyDecision object to store.
516        """
517        if not self._l1_enabled or not config or not isinstance(config, dict):
518            return
519        configurable = config.get("configurable")
520        if isinstance(configurable, dict):
521            if CONFIG_KEY_DECISION_CACHE not in configurable or not isinstance(configurable[CONFIG_KEY_DECISION_CACHE], dict):
522                configurable[CONFIG_KEY_DECISION_CACHE] = {}
523            configurable[CONFIG_KEY_DECISION_CACHE][cache_key] = decision
524
525    def get_static(self, cache_key: str) -> Optional[PolicyDecision]:
526        """Tier 2: Looks up decision in process-wide static cache with TTL.
527
528        Args:
529            cache_key: Hash key.
530
531        Returns:
532            Optional[PolicyDecision]: Unexpired cached decision or None.
533        """
534        if not self._l2_enabled:
535            return None
536        entry = self._tier2_cache.get(cache_key)
537        if entry:
538            decision, ts = entry
539            if time.time() - ts <= self._ttl_seconds:
540                return decision
541            del self._tier2_cache[cache_key]
542        return None
543
544    def put_static(self, cache_key: str, decision: PolicyDecision) -> None:
545        """Tier 2: Stores decision in process-wide static cache with bounded max entries.
546
547        Args:
548            cache_key: Hash key.
549            decision: PolicyDecision to cache.
550        """
551        if not self._l2_enabled:
552            return
553        if len(self._tier2_cache) >= self._max_entries and cache_key not in self._tier2_cache:
554            oldest_key = min(self._tier2_cache.keys(), key=lambda k: self._tier2_cache[k][1])
555            del self._tier2_cache[oldest_key]
556        self._tier2_cache[cache_key] = (decision, time.time())
557
558    def evict_subject(self, subject_id: str, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> int:
559        """Evict all cached policy decisions for a specific subject across L2 and optional L1 config.
560
561        Args:
562            subject_id: Subject identifier whose decisions must be evicted.
563            *args: Optional positional config dict.
564            **kwargs: Optional keyword config dict.
565
566        Returns:
567            int: Count of evicted cache entries.
568        """
569        prefix = f"{subject_id}:"
570        evicted = 0
571        keys_to_remove = [k for k in self._tier2_cache.keys() if k.startswith(prefix)]
572        for k in keys_to_remove:
573            del self._tier2_cache[k]
574            evicted += 1
575
576        config = kwargs.get("config", args[0] if len(args) > 0 else None)
577        if isinstance(config, dict):
578            configurable = config.get("configurable")
579            if isinstance(configurable, dict):
580                inv_cache = configurable.get(CONFIG_KEY_DECISION_CACHE)
581                if isinstance(inv_cache, dict):
582                    l1_keys = [k for k in inv_cache.keys() if k.startswith(prefix)]
583                    for k in l1_keys:
584                        del inv_cache[k]
585                        evicted += 1
586        return evicted
587
588    def flush(self) -> None:
589        """Flush all Tier 2 static cache entries."""
590        self._tier2_cache.clear()

Two-tier caching engine (Tier 1 Invocation-Scoped + Tier 2 Cross-Request Static).

 72    def entity_resolver(self, resolver: Optional[EntityAttributeResolverSPI]) -> None:
 73        """Set or update the entity resolver SPI instance."""
 74        self._entity_resolver = resolver
 75
 76    @property
 77    def last_diagnostic_reason(self) -> Optional[str]:
 78        """Get the diagnostic reason code from the most recent evaluation, if any."""
 79        return self._last_diagnostic_reason
 80
 81    @property
 82    def last_hydrated_entities(self) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
 83        """Get the map of entities hydrated during the most recent evaluation."""
 84        return dict(self._last_hydrated_entities)
 85
 86    def evaluate(
 87        self,
 88        expression: str,
 89        subject: SecurityIdentity,
 90        args: Dict[str, Any],
 91        tool: Dict[str, Any],
 92        *extra_args: Any,
 93        **kwargs: Any,
 94    ) -> bool:
 95        """Evaluate a CEL parameter constraint expression against invocation context.
 96
 97        Args:
 98            expression: Common Expression Language (CEL) boolean condition string.
 99            subject: SecurityIdentity envelope of the calling user or agent.
100            args: Map of resolved runtime argument parameters passed to the tool.
101            tool: Metadata attributes dictionary describing the target tool.
102            *extra_args: Optional positional arguments (e.g., config dictionary).
103            **kwargs: Optional keyword arguments (e.g., config dictionary).
104
105        Returns:
106            bool: True if the expression evaluates to truthy; False on failure or syntax error (fail-closed).
107        """
108        self._last_diagnostic_reason = None
109        self._last_hydrated_entities = {}
110        if not expression or not expression.strip():
111            return True
112
113        config = kwargs.get("config", extra_args[0] if len(extra_args) > 0 else None)
114        normalized_expr = self._preprocess_cel_syntax(expression)
115        eval_scope = self._build_evaluation_scope(subject, args, tool, config)
116
117        try:
118            tree = ast.parse(normalized_expr, mode="eval")
119            result = self._eval_ast_node(tree.body, eval_scope)
120            return bool(result)
121        except KeyError:
122            self._last_diagnostic_reason = DIAGNOSTIC_FAIL_CLOSED_NULL_ENTITY
123            return False
124        except Exception:
125            # Fail closed to DENY (False) on evaluation errors, missing variables, or syntax failures
126            return False
127
128    def _preprocess_cel_syntax(self, expr: str) -> str:
129        """Translates CEL operator syntax (&&, ||, ternary ?) into Python AST syntax."""
130        result = expr.replace("&&", " and ").replace("||", " or ")
131        if "?" in result and ":" in result:
132            parts = result.split("?", 1)
133            condition = parts[0].strip()
134            rest = parts[1]
135            true_false = rest.split(":", 1)
136            true_val = true_false[0].strip()
137            false_val = true_false[1].strip()
138            result = f"({true_val}) if ({condition}) else ({false_val})"
139        return result
140
141    def _build_evaluation_scope(
142        self,
143        subject: SecurityIdentity,
144        args: Dict[str, Any],
145        tool: Dict[str, Any],
146        config: Optional[Dict[str, Any]],
147    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
148        """Constructs attribute dictionary scope for subject, args, tool, and hydrated entities namespaces."""
149        subject_dict = {
150            "id": subject.subject_id,
151            "tenant_id": subject.tenant_id,
152            "tenantId": subject.tenant_id,
153            "roles": subject.roles,
154            "clearance": subject.clearance_level,
155            "clearance_level": subject.clearance_level,
156            "dept": subject.department_id,
157            "department_id": subject.department_id,
158            "attributes": subject.attributes,
159        }
160
161        entity_cache: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
162        if isinstance(config, dict) and isinstance(config.get("configurable"), dict):
163            entity_cache = config["configurable"].setdefault(CONFIG_KEY_ENTITY_CACHE, {})
164
165        entities_scope: Dict[str, Any] = {}
166        if self._entity_resolver:
167            evaluator_ref = self
168
169            class _EntityProxy:
170                def __init__(self, resolver: EntityAttributeResolverSPI, etype: str):
171                    self._resolver = resolver
172                    self._etype = etype
173
174                def _resolve_with_cache(self, eid: str) -> _EntityAttrDict:
175                    cache_key = f"{self._etype}:{eid}"
176                    if cache_key in entity_cache:
177                        res = entity_cache[cache_key]
178                    else:
179                        res = self._resolver.resolve(self._etype, str(eid))
180                        if res is not None:
181                            entity_cache[cache_key] = dict(res)
182                    if res is None:
183                        raise KeyError(f"Unresolvable entity '{eid}' of type '{self._etype}'")
184                    evaluator_ref._last_hydrated_entities[cache_key] = dict(res)
185                    return _EntityAttrDict(res)
186
187                def __getitem__(self, eid: str) -> _EntityAttrDict:
188                    return self._resolve_with_cache(str(eid))
189
190                def __getattr__(self, eid: str) -> _EntityAttrDict:
191                    return self._resolve_with_cache(str(eid))
192
193            class _EntitiesDict(dict):
194                def __init__(self, resolver: EntityAttributeResolverSPI):
195                    self._resolver = resolver
196
197                def __getitem__(self, etype: str) -> Any:
198                    return _EntityProxy(self._resolver, etype)
199
200                def __getattr__(self, etype: str) -> Any:
201                    return _EntityProxy(self._resolver, etype)
202
203            entities_scope = _EntitiesDict(self._entity_resolver)
204
205        return {
206            "subject": _AttrDict(subject_dict),
207            "args": _AttrDict(args),
208            "tool": _AttrDict(tool),
209            "entities": entities_scope,
210            "true": True,
211            "false": False,
212            "null": None,
213            "None": None,
214        }
215
216    def _eval_ast_node(self, node: ast.AST, scope: Dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
217        """Safe AST node recursive evaluation."""
218        if isinstance(node, ast.Expression):
219            return self._eval_ast_node(node.body, scope)
220
221        if isinstance(node, ast.Constant):
222            return node.value
223
224        if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
225            if node.id in scope:
226                return scope[node.id]
227            raise NameError(f"Undefined variable in expression: '{node.id}'")
228
229        if isinstance(node, ast.Attribute):
230            obj = self._eval_ast_node(node.value, scope)
231            if hasattr(obj, node.attr):
232                return getattr(obj, node.attr)
233            if isinstance(obj, str):
234                if node.attr == "startsWith":
235                    return obj.startswith
236                elif node.attr == "endsWith":
237                    return obj.endswith
238                elif node.attr == "contains":
239                    return lambda sub: sub in obj
240                elif node.attr in ("toLowerCase", "lower"):
241                    return obj.lower
242                elif node.attr in ("toUpperCase", "upper"):
243                    return obj.upper
244            if isinstance(obj, dict) and node.attr in obj:
245                return obj[node.attr]
246            return None
247
248        if isinstance(node, ast.Subscript):
249            value = self._eval_ast_node(node.value, scope)
250            slice_val = self._eval_ast_node(node.slice, scope)
251            return value[slice_val]
252
253        if isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp):
254            operand = self._eval_ast_node(node.operand, scope)
255            if isinstance(node.op, ast.Not):
256                return not operand
257            if isinstance(node.op, ast.USub):
258                return -operand
259            if isinstance(node.op, ast.UAdd):
260                return +operand
261
262        if isinstance(node, ast.BinOp):
263            left = self._eval_ast_node(node.left, scope)
264            right = self._eval_ast_node(node.right, scope)
265            if isinstance(node.op, ast.Add):
266                return left + right
267            if isinstance(node.op, ast.Sub):
268                return left - right
269            if isinstance(node.op, ast.Mult):
270                return left * right
271            if isinstance(node.op, ast.Div):
272                return left / right
273            if isinstance(node.op, ast.Mod):
274                return left % right
275
276        if isinstance(node, ast.BoolOp):
277            values = [self._eval_ast_node(val, scope) for val in node.values]
278            if isinstance(node.op, ast.And):
279                return all(values)
280            if isinstance(node.op, ast.Or):
281                return any(values)
282
283        if isinstance(node, ast.Compare):
284            left = self._eval_ast_node(node.left, scope)
285            for op, comparator in zip(node.ops, node.comparators):
286                right = self._eval_ast_node(comparator, scope)
287                if isinstance(op, ast.Eq) and not (left == right):
288                    return False
289                elif isinstance(op, ast.NotEq) and not (left != right):
290                    return False
291                elif isinstance(op, ast.Lt) and not (left < right):
292                    return False
293                elif isinstance(op, ast.LtE) and not (left <= right):
294                    return False
295                elif isinstance(op, ast.Gt) and not (left > right):
296                    return False
297                elif isinstance(op, ast.GtE) and not (left >= right):
298                    return False
299                elif isinstance(op, ast.In) and not (left in right):
300                    return False
301                elif isinstance(op, ast.NotIn) and not (left not in right):
302                    return False
303                left = right
304            return True
305
306        if isinstance(node, ast.IfExp):
307            test = self._eval_ast_node(node.test, scope)
308            if test:
309                return self._eval_ast_node(node.body, scope)
310            else:
311                return self._eval_ast_node(node.orelse, scope)
312
313        if isinstance(node, ast.Call):
314            func = self._eval_ast_node(node.func, scope)
315            args = [self._eval_ast_node(arg, scope) for arg in node.args]
316            if callable(func):
317                return func(*args)
318            return None
319
320        if isinstance(node, ast.List):
321            return [self._eval_ast_node(el, scope) for el in node.elts]
322
323        if isinstance(node, ast.Tuple):
324            return tuple(self._eval_ast_node(el, scope) for el in node.elts)
325
326        if isinstance(node, ast.Set):
327            return set(self._eval_ast_node(el, scope) for el in node.elts)
328
329        if isinstance(node, ast.Dict):
330            keys = [self._eval_ast_node(k, scope) for k in node.keys]
331            vals = [self._eval_ast_node(v, scope) for v in node.values]
332            return dict(zip(keys, vals))
333
334        raise TypeError(f"Unsupported AST node type: {type(node).__name__}")

Evaluates parameter constraint expressions safely over evaluation context.

 35class AuditEvent:
 36    """OCSF-aligned tamper-evident structured audit evaluation record.
 37
 38    Attributes:
 39        event_id (str): Unique UUID string for event identification.
 40        schema_version (str): Audit schema version specification.
 41        timestamp_utc (float): UTC timestamp in seconds since epoch.
 42        invocation_id (str): Unique trace context or invocation ID.
 43        trace_id (Optional[str]): OpenTelemetry trace ID.
 44        span_id (Optional[str]): OpenTelemetry span ID.
 45        subject_id (str): Caller subject identifier.
 46        tenant_id (str): Tenant isolation boundary identifier.
 47        subject_roles (List[str]): Roles assigned to caller.
 48        subject_clearance (int): Clearance level rank.
 49        enforcement_point (str): Enforcement point identifier.
 50        action (str): Action string requested.
 51        target_resource (str): Target resource path or name.
 52        decision (str): PDP decision outcome ('PERMIT', 'DENY', 'BLOCKED', etc.).
 53        reason_code (str): Standardized security event reason code.
 54        diagnostic_reason (str): Human-readable diagnostic description.
 55        severity (str): Event severity level string.
 56        payload_snapshot (Dict[str, Any]): Sanitized payload snapshot.
 57        threat_category (Optional[str]): Threat classification label.
 58        threat_score (Optional[float]): Threat confidence score.
 59        detected_pattern (Optional[str]): Injection pattern ID.
 60        mitigation_action (Optional[str]): Mitigation strategy applied.
 61        sequence_number (int): Monotonic audit sequence number.
 62        envelope_hmac (Optional[str]): Signature hash for tamper evidence.
 63    """
 64
 65    def __init__(
 66        self,
 67        event_id: str,
 68        schema_version: str,
 69        timestamp_utc: float,
 70        invocation_id: str,
 71        trace_id: Optional[str],
 72        span_id: Optional[str],
 73        subject_id: str,
 74        tenant_id: str,

 80        decision: str,
 81        reason_code: str,
 82        diagnostic_reason: str,
 83        severity: str,
 84        payload_snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
 85        threat_category: Optional[str] = None,
 86        threat_score: Optional[float] = None,
 87        detected_pattern: Optional[str] = None,
 88        mitigation_action: Optional[str] = None,
 89        sequence_number: int = 0,
 90        envelope_hmac: Optional[str] = None,
 91    ):
 92        """Initialize AuditEvent.
 93
 94        Args:
 95            event_id: Unique UUID string for event identification.
 96            schema_version: Audit schema version string.
 97            timestamp_utc: UTC timestamp in seconds since epoch.
 98            invocation_id: Unique trace context or invocation ID.
 99            trace_id: OpenTelemetry trace ID if present.
100            span_id: OpenTelemetry span ID if present.
101            subject_id: Caller subject identifier.
102            tenant_id: Multi-tenant boundary identifier.
103            subject_roles: Roles assigned to caller.
104            subject_clearance: Clearance rank assigned to caller.
105            enforcement_point: Enforcement point identifier.
106            action: Requested action identifier.
107            target_resource: Target resource path or name.
108            decision: PDP decision verdict.
109            reason_code: Standardized security event reason code.
110            diagnostic_reason: Human-readable diagnostic description.
111            severity: Event severity level.
112            payload_snapshot: Sanitized payload snapshot dictionary.
113            threat_category: Optional threat classification category.
114            threat_score: Optional threat confidence score.
115            detected_pattern: Optional injection pattern identifier.
116            mitigation_action: Optional mitigation strategy applied.
117            sequence_number: Monotonic audit sequence number.
118            envelope_hmac: Optional HMAC signature for tamper evidence.
119        """
120        self.event_id = event_id
121        self.schema_version = schema_version
122        self.timestamp_utc = timestamp_utc
123        self.invocation_id = invocation_id
124        self.trace_id = trace_id
125        self.span_id = span_id
126        self.subject_id = subject_id

128        self.subject_roles = list(subject_roles)
129        self.subject_clearance = subject_clearance
130        self.enforcement_point = enforcement_point

132        self.target_resource = target_resource
133        self.decision = decision
134        self.reason_code = reason_code
135        self.diagnostic_reason = diagnostic_reason
136        self.severity = severity
137        self.payload_snapshot = dict(payload_snapshot)

139        self.threat_score = threat_score
140        self.detected_pattern = detected_pattern
141        self.mitigation_action = mitigation_action
142        self.sequence_number = sequence_number
143        self.envelope_hmac = envelope_hmac

145    @classmethod
146    def create(
147        cls,
148        subject_id: str,
149        tenant_id: str,
150        action: str,
151        resource: str,
152        decision: str,
153        diagnostic_reason: str,
154        severity: str,
155        metadata: Dict[str, Any],
156        enforcement_point: str = "SYSTEM_BOUNDARY",
157        reason_code: str = "POLICY_EVALUATION",
158    ):
159        """Factory method to construct an AuditEvent with OpenTelemetry trace extraction.
160
161        Args:
162            subject_id: Subject identifier.
163            tenant_id: Tenant ID.
164            action: Requested action.
165            resource: Resource path/name.
166            decision: Decision verdict.
167            diagnostic_reason: Rationale description.
168            severity: Severity level.
169            metadata: Payload snapshot dictionary.
170            enforcement_point: PEP point ID.
171            reason_code: Event reason code.
172
173        Returns:
174            AuditEvent: Constructed audit event instance.
175        """
176        trace_id = metadata.get("trace_id")
177        span_id = metadata.get("span_id")
178        if trace_id is None or span_id is None:
179            try:
180                from opentelemetry import trace
181                current_span = trace.get_current_span()
182                if current_span and current_span.get_span_context().is_valid:
183                    ctx = current_span.get_span_context()
184                    if trace_id is None:
185                        trace_id = f"{ctx.trace_id:032x}"
186                    if span_id is None:
187                        span_id = f"{ctx.span_id:016x}"
188            except Exception:
189                pass
190
191        return cls(
192            event_id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
193            schema_version=DEFAULT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
194            timestamp_utc=time.time(),
195            invocation_id=metadata.get("invocation_id", str(uuid.uuid4())),
196            trace_id=trace_id,
197            span_id=span_id,
198            subject_id=subject_id,
199            tenant_id=tenant_id,
200            subject_roles=metadata.get("subject_roles", []),
201            subject_clearance=int(metadata.get("subject_clearance", 0)),
202            enforcement_point=enforcement_point,
203            action=action,

@classmethod
def create( cls, subject_id: str, tenant_id: str, action: str, resource: str, decision: str, diagnostic_reason: str, severity: str, metadata: Dict[str, Any], enforcement_point: str = 'SYSTEM_BOUNDARY', reason_code: str = 'POLICY_EVALUATION'): 
145    @classmethod
146    def create(
147        cls,
148        subject_id: str,
149        tenant_id: str,
150        action: str,
151        resource: str,
152        decision: str,
153        diagnostic_reason: str,
154        severity: str,
155        metadata: Dict[str, Any],
156        enforcement_point: str = "SYSTEM_BOUNDARY",
157        reason_code: str = "POLICY_EVALUATION",
158    ):
159        """Factory method to construct an AuditEvent with OpenTelemetry trace extraction.
160
161        Args:
162            subject_id: Subject identifier.
163            tenant_id: Tenant ID.
164            action: Requested action.
165            resource: Resource path/name.
166            decision: Decision verdict.
167            diagnostic_reason: Rationale description.
168            severity: Severity level.
169            metadata: Payload snapshot dictionary.
170            enforcement_point: PEP point ID.
171            reason_code: Event reason code.
172
173        Returns:
174            AuditEvent: Constructed audit event instance.
175        """
176        trace_id = metadata.get("trace_id")
177        span_id = metadata.get("span_id")
178        if trace_id is None or span_id is None:
179            try:
180                from opentelemetry import trace
181                current_span = trace.get_current_span()
182                if current_span and current_span.get_span_context().is_valid:
183                    ctx = current_span.get_span_context()
184                    if trace_id is None:
185                        trace_id = f"{ctx.trace_id:032x}"
186                    if span_id is None:
187                        span_id = f"{ctx.span_id:016x}"
188            except Exception:
189                pass
190
191        return cls(
192            event_id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
193            schema_version=DEFAULT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
194            timestamp_utc=time.time(),
195            invocation_id=metadata.get("invocation_id", str(uuid.uuid4())),
196            trace_id=trace_id,
197            span_id=span_id,
198            subject_id=subject_id,
199            tenant_id=tenant_id,
200            subject_roles=metadata.get("subject_roles", []),
201            subject_clearance=int(metadata.get("subject_clearance", 0)),
202            enforcement_point=enforcement_point,
203            action=action,
204            target_resource=resource,
205            decision=decision,
206            reason_code=reason_code,
207            diagnostic_reason=diagnostic_reason,
208            severity=severity,
209            payload_snapshot=metadata,
210        )

547class AuditManager:
548    """Central manager for non-blocking asynchronous audit event dispatch and ring buffer management."""
549
550    def __init__(self, publishers: List[AuditPublisherSPI], *args: Any, **kwargs: Any):
551        """Initialize AuditManager.
552
553        Args:
554            publishers: List of AuditPublisherSPI publisher implementations.
555            *args: Optional positional arguments (capacity).
556            **kwargs: Optional keyword arguments (capacity).
557        """
558        capacity = int(kwargs.get("capacity", args[0] if len(args) > 0 else DEFAULT_RING_BUFFER_CAPACITY))
559        self._publishers = list(publishers)
560        self._capacity = capacity
561        self._buffer: deque = deque()
562        self._dropped_count = 0
563        self._async_queue: Optional[Any] = None
564        self._lock = threading.Lock()
565        self._queue_condition = threading.Condition(self._lock)
566        self._stop_event = threading.Event()
567        self._worker_thread = threading.Thread(
568            target=self._worker_loop,
569            name="AuditManagerAsyncWorker",
570            daemon=True,
571        )
572        self._worker_thread.start()
573
574    @classmethod
575    def create(cls, publishers: List[AuditPublisherSPI], *args: Any, **kwargs: Any):
576        """Factory method to construct AuditManager.
577
578        Args:
579            publishers: List of AuditPublisherSPI publisher implementations.
580            *args: Optional positional arguments (capacity).
581            **kwargs: Optional keyword arguments (capacity).
582
583        Returns:
584            AuditManager: Initialized manager instance with background async worker thread.
585        """
586        capacity = int(kwargs.get("capacity", args[0] if len(args) > 0 else DEFAULT_RING_BUFFER_CAPACITY))
587        return cls(publishers=publishers, capacity=capacity)
588
589    @property
590    def publishers(self) -> List[AuditPublisherSPI]:
591        """Get copy of registered audit publisher SPIs."""
592        return list(self._publishers)
593
594    @property
595    def dropped_count(self) -> int:
596        """Get count of audit events dropped due to buffer overflow."""
597        with self._lock:
598            return self._dropped_count
599
600    def _worker_loop(self) -> None:
601        """Background worker thread draining events asynchronously from the bounded queue."""
602        while not self._stop_event.is_set():
603            event = None
604            with self._queue_condition:
605                while not self._buffer and not self._stop_event.is_set():
606                    self._queue_condition.wait(timeout=0.1)
607                if self._buffer:
608                    event = self._buffer.popleft()
609            if event is not None:
610                self._dispatch_to_publishers(event)
611
612        # Drain remaining events on shutdown
613        while True:
614            event = None
615            with self._lock:
616                if self._buffer:
617                    event = self._buffer.popleft()
618            if event is None:
619                break
620            self._dispatch_to_publishers(event)
621
622    def _dispatch_to_publishers(self, event: AuditEvent) -> None:
623        """Dispatch event to registered publishers catching exceptions safely."""
624        for pub in self._publishers:
625            if not getattr(pub, "is_immediate", False):
626                try:
627                    pub.publish(event)
628                except Exception:
629                    pass
630
631    def record_event(self, event: AuditEvent) -> None:
632        """Execute in-flight sanitization and non-blocking dispatch to ring buffer.
633
634        Args:
635            event: AuditEvent instance to sanitize and record.
636        """
637        if get_pii_scope() != PII_SCOPE_DISABLED:
638            ctx = PiiContext.create(
639                PII_STAGE_AUDIT_PAYLOAD,
640                event.tenant_id,
641                event.subject_id,
642                event.target_resource,
643                {"action": event.action, "enforcement_point": event.enforcement_point},
644            )
645            sanitizer = get_pii_sanitizer()
646            if isinstance(event.payload_snapshot, dict):
647                event.payload_snapshot = sanitizer.sanitize_payload(event.payload_snapshot, ctx)
648            if isinstance(event.diagnostic_reason, str):
649                event.diagnostic_reason = sanitizer.sanitize_text(event.diagnostic_reason, ctx, DEFAULT_PAYLOAD_MAX_CHARS)
650
651        # Immediate dispatch for synchronous publishers (e.g. test collectors)
652        for pub in self._publishers:
653            if getattr(pub, "is_immediate", False):
654                try:
655                    pub.publish(event)
656                except Exception:
657                    pass
658
659        with self._queue_condition:
660            if len(self._buffer) >= self._capacity:
661                self._buffer.popleft()  # DROP_OLDEST_WITH_METRIC
662                self._dropped_count += 1
663            self._buffer.append(event)
664            self._queue_condition.notify()
665
666        if self._async_queue:
667            try:
668                self._async_queue.put_nowait(event)
669            except Exception:
670                pass
671
672    def publish(self, event: AuditEvent) -> None:
673        """Alias for record_event.
674
675        Args:
676            event: AuditEvent instance.
677        """
678        self.record_event(event)
679
680    def flush(self) -> None:
681        """Flush queued events and all registered audit publishers."""
682        # Wait until internal bounded buffer is completely drained by worker thread
683        deadline = time.time() + 2.0
684        while time.time() < deadline:
685            with self._lock:
686                if not self._buffer:
687                    break
688            time.sleep(0.005)
689
690        for pub in self._publishers:
691            try:
692                pub.flush()
693            except Exception:
694                pass
695
696    def close(self) -> None:
697        """Flush and close all registered audit publishers, stopping worker thread."""
698        self._stop_event.set()
699        with self._queue_condition:
700            self._queue_condition.notify_all()
701        if self._worker_thread.is_alive():
702            self._worker_thread.join(timeout=1.0)
703
704        self.flush()
705        for pub in self._publishers:
706            try:
707                pub.close()
708            except Exception:
709                pass

Central manager for non-blocking asynchronous audit event dispatch and ring buffer management.
