class PromptInjectionScanner: 
 57class PromptInjectionScanner:
 58    """Rule-based heuristic scanner for prompt injection, jailbreak, and instruction overrides."""
 59
 60    INJECTION_PATTERNS = [
 61        (
 62            "JAILBREAK_SYSTEM_OVERRIDE",
 63            re.compile(
 64                r"(ignore\s+all\s+(previous|prior)\s+instructions|disregard\s+(all\s+)?previous\s+rules|system\s*:\s*you\s+are\s+now|forget\s+your\s+safety\s+guidelines)",
 65                re.IGNORECASE,
 66            ),
 67            0.95,
 68        ),
 69        (
 70            "ROLEPLAY_DAN_EVASION",
 71            re.compile(
 72                r"(do\s+anything\s+now|dan\s+mode|jailbroken|unrestricted\s+ai|act\s+as\s+an\s+unfiltered)",
 73                re.IGNORECASE,
 74            ),
 75            0.90,
 76        ),
 77        (
 78            "INSTRUCTION_HIJACKING",
 79            re.compile(
 80                r"(\[system\]|###\s*instruction|override_policy\s*=\s*true|<\|im_start\|>system)",
 81                re.IGNORECASE,
 82            ),
 83            0.90,
 84        ),
 85    ]
 86    """Pre-compiled regular expression rules and confidence weights for injection scanning."""
 87
 88    def __init__(self, audit_manager: Optional[AuditManager] = None):
 89        """Initialize PromptInjectionScanner.
 90
 91        Args:
 92            audit_manager: Optional AuditManager for recording injection alerts.
 93        """
 94        self._audit_manager = audit_manager
 95
 96    @classmethod
 97    def create(cls, audit_manager: Optional[AuditManager] = None):
 98        """Factory method to construct PromptInjectionScanner.
 99
100        Args:
101            audit_manager: Optional AuditManager instance.
102
103        Returns:
104            PromptInjectionScanner: New scanner instance.
105        """
106        return cls(audit_manager=audit_manager)
107
108    def scan_text(self, text: str) -> PromptInjectionScanResult:
109        """Scan input text string for prompt injection and jailbreak signatures.
110
111        Args:
112            text: Input text string to scan.
113
114        Returns:
115            PromptInjectionScanResult: Scan result containing match status and threat details.
116        """
117        if not text or not isinstance(text, str):
118            return PromptInjectionScanResult(is_detected=False)
119
120        for pattern_id, regex, score in self.INJECTION_PATTERNS:
121            match = regex.search(text)
122            if match:
123                snippet = match.group(0)
124                category = "INSTRUCTION_OVERRIDE" if "INSTRUCTION" in pattern_id else "PROMPT_INJECTION"
125                return PromptInjectionScanResult(
126                    is_detected=True,
127                    pattern_id=pattern_id,
128                    threat_score=score,
129                    threat_category=category,
130                    detected_text=snippet,
131                )
132
133        return PromptInjectionScanResult(is_detected=False)
134
135    def scan_and_audit(
136        self,
137        text: str,
138        subject_id: str,
139        tenant_id: str,
140        enforcement_point: str = PEP_AGENT_GUARD,
141        context_metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
142    ) -> PromptInjectionScanResult:
143        """Scan input text and publish audit security alert event if threat is detected.
144
145        Args:
146            text: Input text string.
147            subject_id: Subject attempting execution.
148            tenant_id: Tenant identifier.
149            enforcement_point: Target PEP identifier string.
150            context_metadata: Optional additional metadata dictionary.
151
152        Returns:
153            PromptInjectionScanResult: Scan result envelope.
154        """
155        result = self.scan_text(text)
156        if result.is_detected and self._audit_manager:
157            event_type = (
158                EVENT_INSTRUCTION_OVERRIDE_ATTEMPT
159                if result.threat_category == "INSTRUCTION_OVERRIDE"
160                else EVENT_PROMPT_INJECTION_DETECTED
161            )
162            severity = (
163                SEVERITY_CRITICAL_ALERT
164                if result.threat_score >= 0.9
165                else SEVERITY_SECURITY_ALERT
166            )
167
168            meta = dict(context_metadata) if context_metadata else {}
169            meta.update({
170                "detected_snippet": result.detected_text,
171                "threat_score": result.threat_score,
172                "pattern_id": result.pattern_id,
173            })
174
175            event = AuditEvent.create(
176                subject_id=subject_id,
177                tenant_id=tenant_id,
178                action="prompt:scan",
179                resource=enforcement_point,
180                decision="BLOCKED",
181                diagnostic_reason=f"Prompt injection pattern detected: '{result.pattern_id}'",
182                severity=severity,
183                metadata=meta,
184                enforcement_point=enforcement_point,
185                reason_code=event_type,
186            )
187            event.threat_category = result.threat_category
188            event.threat_score = result.threat_score
189            event.detected_pattern = result.pattern_id
190            event.mitigation_action = STRATEGY_HARD_ABORT
191
192            self._audit_manager.record_event(event)
193
194        return result

Rule-based heuristic scanner for prompt injection, jailbreak, and instruction overrides.

190            event.mitigation_action = STRATEGY_HARD_ABORT
191
192            self._audit_manager.record_event(event)
193
194        return result

class BuiltInPiiSanitizer(langchain_security_extension.security_core.PiiSanitizerSPI): 
239class BuiltInPiiSanitizer(PiiSanitizerSPI):
240    """Default zero-dependency high-performance PII and credential scrubber.
241
242    Performs 3-stage sanitization:
243    - Stage 1: Key-name masking for sensitive dictionary parameters.
244    - Stage 2: Comprehensive regex matching for emails, phones, SSNs, credit cards (with Luhn),
245               cloud credentials (AWS, Google, GitHub, Slack), JWTs, DB URIs, and private keys.
246    - Stage 3: Payload size truncation to prevent log bloat.
247    """
248
249    COMBINED_SECRET_REGEX = re.compile(
250        r'(?P<db_uri>(?:postgres(?:ql)?|mysql|mongodb(?:\+srv)?|redis)://[^:\s/]+:[^@\s/]+@[^\s,\'"]+)'
251        r'|(?P<kv_secret>(?:bearer[\s=]+[^\s,\'"]+|password\s*[:=]\s*[^\s,\'"]+|secret\s*[:=]\s*[^\s,\'"]+|token\s*[:=]\s*[^\s,\'"]+|api[_\-]?key\s*[:=]\s*[^\s,\'"]+|aws[_\-]?key\s*[:=]\s*[^\s,\'"]+))'
252        r'|(?P<jwt>eyJ[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]{5,}\.eyJ[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]{5,}\.[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]{5,})'
253        r'|(?P<aws_key>(?:AKIA|ASIA)[0-9A-Z]{16})'
254        r'|(?P<google_key>AIza[-0-9A-Za-z_]{35})'
255        r'|(?P<github_token>gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9_]{36,255})'
256        r'|(?P<slack_token>xox[baprs]-[-0-9A-Za-z]{10,72})'
257        r'|(?P<private_key>-----BEGIN [A-Z\s]+ PRIVATE KEY-----[A-Za-z0-9+/=\s]+-----END [A-Z\s]+ PRIVATE KEY-----)'
258        r'|(?P<email>\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,7}\b)'
259        r'|(?P<ipv4>\b(?:(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)\.){3}(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)\b)'
260        r'|(?P<pan>\b[A-Za-z]{5}[-\s]?[0-9]{4}[-\s]?[A-Za-z]\b)'
261        r'|(?P<card>\b(?:\d{4}[-\s]?){3}\d{1,7}\b|\b\d{13,19}\b)'
262        r'|(?P<aadhaar>(?<!\d)[2-9]\d{3}[-\s]\d{4}[-\s]\d{4}(?![-\s]?\d)|\b[2-9]\d{11}\b|(?<!\d)\d{4}[-\s]\d{4}[-\s]\d{4}(?![-\s]?\d)|\b\d{12}\b)'
263        r'|(?P<ssn>\b\d{3}[-\s]\d{2}[-\s]\d{4}\b|\b\d{9}\b)'
264        r'|(?P<phone>(?:\+\d{1,3}[-.\s]?)?(?:\(\d{3}\)[-.\s]?|\b\d{3}[-.\s])\d{3}[-.\s]\d{4}\b|\b\d{10}\b)',
265        re.IGNORECASE,
266    )
267
268    PHONE_HINT_REGEX = re.compile(DEFAULT_PHONE_HINT_PATTERN, re.IGNORECASE)
269    SSN_HINT_REGEX = re.compile(DEFAULT_SSN_HINT_PATTERN, re.IGNORECASE)
270    AADHAAR_HINT_REGEX = re.compile(DEFAULT_AADHAAR_HINT_PATTERN, re.IGNORECASE)
271    PAN_HINT_REGEX = re.compile(DEFAULT_PAN_HINT_PATTERN, re.IGNORECASE)
272
273
274    def __init__(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any):
275        """Initialize BuiltInPiiSanitizer.
276
277        Args:
278            *args: Optional positional arguments (masked_fields).
279            **kwargs: Optional keyword arguments (masked_fields).
280        """
281        masked_fields = kwargs.get("masked_fields", args[0] if len(args) > 0 else ())
282        self._registered_masked_fields: Set[str] = {
283            str(f).lower().strip() for f in DEFAULT_SENSITIVE_FIELD_NAMES
284        }
285        if masked_fields:
286            for field in masked_fields:
287                self.register_masked_field(str(field))
288

290    def create(cls, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> "BuiltInPiiSanitizer":
291        """Factory method to construct a BuiltInPiiSanitizer.
292
293        Args:
294            *args: Optional positional arguments (masked_fields).
295            **kwargs: Optional keyword arguments (masked_fields).
296
297        Returns:

299        """

302    def register_masked_field(self, field_name: str) -> None:
303        """Register a parameter or field name for automatic Stage 1 dictionary masking.
304
305        Args:
306            field_name: Name of field or argument to redact when encountered in dictionaries.
307        """
308        if field_name:
309            self._registered_masked_fields.add(field_name.lower().strip())
310
311    def is_masked_field(self, field_name: str) -> bool:
312        """Check if a field name is marked as sensitive/masked.
313
314        Args:
315            field_name: Field name to query.
316
317        Returns:
318            bool: True if the field is registered as sensitive/masked, False otherwise.
319        """
320        return bool(field_name and field_name.lower().strip() in self._registered_masked_fields)
321
322    def _redact_match(self, match: re.Match, full_text: str) -> str:
323        group_dict = match.groupdict()
324        text = match.group(0)
325
326        if group_dict.get("db_uri"):
327            scheme_user = text.split(":", 2)
328            at_part = text.split("@", 1)[1]
329            return f"{scheme_user[0]}:{scheme_user[1]}:{REDACTED_TOKEN}@{at_part}"
330
331        if group_dict.get("kv_secret"):
332            if "=" in text:
333                prefix = text.split("=")[0]
334                return f"{prefix}={REDACTED_TOKEN}"
335            elif ":" in text:
336                prefix = text.split(":")[0]
337                return f"{prefix}: {REDACTED_TOKEN}"
338            elif text.lower().startswith("bearer "):
339                return f"bearer {REDACTED_TOKEN}"
340            return REDACTED_TOKEN
341
342        if group_dict.get("pan"):
343            if is_valid_pan(text):
344                return REDACTED_TOKEN
345            return text
346
347        if group_dict.get("aadhaar"):
348            digits = "".join(c for c in text if c.isdigit())
349            if len(digits) == 12:
350                start_idx = max(0, match.start() - AADHAAR_CONTEXT_WINDOW_CHARS)
351                end_idx = min(len(full_text), match.end() + AADHAAR_CONTEXT_WINDOW_CHARS)
352                window = full_text[start_idx:end_idx]
353                has_hint = bool(self.AADHAAR_HINT_REGEX.search(window))
354                if has_hint:
355                    return REDACTED_TOKEN
356                if is_valid_aadhaar(digits):
357                    if not any(c in text for c in "- "):
358                        return text
359                    return REDACTED_TOKEN
360            return text
361
362        if group_dict.get("card"):
363            digits = "".join(c for c in text if c.isdigit())
364            if is_valid_luhn(digits):
365                return REDACTED_TOKEN
366            return text
367
368        if group_dict.get("ssn"):
369            digits = "".join(c for c in text if c.isdigit())
370            # For 9-digit numbers lacking SSN formatting delimiters, require proximity to SSN keywords
371            if len(digits) == 9 and not any(c in text for c in "- "):
372                start_idx = max(0, match.start() - SSN_CONTEXT_WINDOW_CHARS)
373                end_idx = min(len(full_text), match.end() + SSN_CONTEXT_WINDOW_CHARS)
374                window = full_text[start_idx:end_idx]
375                if not self.SSN_HINT_REGEX.search(window):
376                    return text
377            return REDACTED_TOKEN
378
379        if group_dict.get("phone"):
380            digits = "".join(c for c in text if c.isdigit())
381            # For 10-digit numbers lacking phone formatting delimiters, require proximity to phone/fone keywords
382            if len(digits) == 10 and not any(c in text for c in "-. ()+"):
383                start_idx = max(0, match.start() - PHONE_CONTEXT_WINDOW_CHARS)
384                end_idx = min(len(full_text), match.end() + PHONE_CONTEXT_WINDOW_CHARS)
385                window = full_text[start_idx:end_idx]
386                if not self.PHONE_HINT_REGEX.search(window):
387                    return text
388            return REDACTED_TOKEN
389
390        return REDACTED_TOKEN
391
392    def sanitize_text(
393        self,
394        text: str,
395        context: Optional[PiiContext],
396        *args: Any,
397        **kwargs: Any,
398    ) -> str:
399        """Sanitize sensitive entities in raw text strings.
400
401        Args:
402            text: Raw input string to inspect and sanitize.
403            context: Optional PiiContext detailing lifecycle stage and caller identity.
404            *args: Optional positional arguments (e.g. max_chars limit).
405            **kwargs: Optional keyword arguments (e.g. max_chars limit).
406
407        Returns:
408            str: Redacted string with credentials, PII tokens, and secrets obscured.
409        """
410        max_chars = int(kwargs.get("max_chars", args[0] if len(args) > 0 else DEFAULT_PAYLOAD_MAX_CHARS))
411        cleaned = self.COMBINED_SECRET_REGEX.sub(lambda m: self._redact_match(m, text), text)
412        if len(cleaned) > max_chars:
413            cleaned = cleaned[:max_chars] + TRUNCATED_SUFFIX
414        return cleaned
415
416    def sanitize_payload(
417        self,
418        payload: Dict[str, Any],
419        context: Optional[PiiContext],
420        *args: Any,
421        **kwargs: Any,
422    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
423        """Recursively sanitize a dictionary payload.
424
425        Args:
426            payload: Input dictionary containing parameters or telemetry data.
427            context: Optional PiiContext detailing lifecycle stage and caller identity.
428            *args: Optional positional arguments (max_chars, masked_fields).
429            **kwargs: Optional keyword arguments (max_chars, masked_fields).
430
431        Returns:
432            Dict[str, Any]: New dictionary with sensitive fields and in-string PII redacted.
433        """
434        max_chars = int(kwargs.get("max_chars", args[0] if len(args) > 0 else DEFAULT_PAYLOAD_MAX_CHARS))
435        extra_masked = set(kwargs.get("masked_fields", args[1] if len(args) > 1 else ()))
436        masked_lower = {str(f).lower() for f in extra_masked} | self._registered_masked_fields
437
438        sanitized: Dict[str, Any] = {}
439        for k, v in payload.items():
440            if str(k).lower() in masked_lower:
441                sanitized[k] = REDACTED_TOKEN
442            elif isinstance(v, str):
443                sanitized[k] = self.sanitize_text(v, context, max_chars)
444            elif isinstance(v, dict):
445                sanitized[k] = self.sanitize_payload(v, context, max_chars, extra_masked)
446            elif isinstance(v, list):
447                sanitized[k] = [
448                    self.sanitize_payload(item, context, max_chars, extra_masked)
449                    if isinstance(item, dict)
450                    else (self.sanitize_text(item, context, max_chars) if isinstance(item, str) else item)
451                    for item in v
452                ]
453            else:
454                sanitized[k] = v
455        return sanitized

Default zero-dependency high-performance PII and credential scrubber.

Performs 3-stage sanitization:

  • Stage 1: Key-name masking for sensitive dictionary parameters.
  • Stage 2: Comprehensive regex matching for emails, phones, SSNs, credit cards (with Luhn), cloud credentials (AWS, Google, GitHub, Slack), JWTs, DB URIs, and private keys.
  • Stage 3: Payload size truncation to prevent log bloat.

AADHAAR_HINT_REGEX = re.compile('(?i)\\b(?:aadhaar|aadhar|adhar|uidai|uid)\\b', re.IGNORECASE)
PAN_HINT_REGEX = re.compile('(?i)\\b(?:pan|permanent\\s+account\\s+number)\\b', re.IGNORECASE)

def is_valid_luhn(card_number_str: str) -> bool: 
70def is_valid_luhn(card_number_str: str) -> bool:
71    """Validate candidate credit/debit card number using the Luhn checksum algorithm.
72
73    Args:
74        card_number_str: String containing card number digits with optional delimiters.
75
76    Returns:
77        bool: True if digits satisfy the Luhn mod-10 formula, False otherwise.
78    """
79    digits = [int(c) for c in card_number_str if c.isdigit()]
80    if len(digits) < 13 or len(digits) > 19:
81        return False
82    checksum = 0
83    reverse_digits = digits[::-1]
84    for i, digit in enumerate(reverse_digits):
85        if i % 2 == 1:
86            doubled = digit * 2
87            checksum += doubled - 9 if doubled > 9 else doubled
88        else:
89            checksum += digit
90    return checksum % 10 == 0

Validate candidate credit/debit card number using the Luhn checksum algorithm.

Args: card_number_str: String containing card number digits with optional delimiters.

Returns: bool: True if digits satisfy the Luhn mod-10 formula, False otherwise.

def is_valid_verhoeff(number_str: str) -> bool: 
 93def is_valid_verhoeff(number_str: str) -> bool:
 94    """Validate candidate identification number using the Verhoeff checksum algorithm.
 95
 96    Args:
 97        number_str: Numeric string to validate against dihedral group D5 permutations.
 98
 99    Returns:
100        bool: True if the Verhoeff checksum digit is valid, False otherwise.
101    """
102    digits = [int(c) for c in number_str if c.isdigit()]
103    if not digits:
104        return False
105    checksum = 0
106    for i, digit in enumerate(reversed(digits)):
107        checksum = VERHOEFF_D_TABLE[checksum][VERHOEFF_P_TABLE[i % 8][digit]]
108    return checksum == 0

Validate candidate identification number using the Verhoeff checksum algorithm.

Args: number_str: Numeric string to validate against dihedral group D5 permutations.

Returns: bool: True if the Verhoeff checksum digit is valid, False otherwise.

def is_valid_aadhaar(aadhaar_str: str) -> bool: 
111def is_valid_aadhaar(aadhaar_str: str) -> bool:
112    """Validate candidate Indian Aadhaar number (12 digits, starts with 2-9, valid Verhoeff checksum).
113
114    Args:
115        aadhaar_str: Candidate Aadhaar number string with optional spaces or hyphens.
116
117    Returns:
118        bool: True if length is 12, first digit is 2-9, and Verhoeff checksum succeeds; False otherwise.
119    """
120    digits = [c for c in aadhaar_str if c.isdigit()]
121    if len(digits) != 12:
122        return False
123    if digits[0] in ("0", "1"):
124        return False
125    return is_valid_verhoeff("".join(digits))

128def is_valid_pan(pan_str: str) -> bool:
129    """Validate candidate Indian PAN structure (5 letters, 4 digits, 1 letter).
130
